usage: The word '鵝' refers to the bird species goose and is used as a noun.
You can use '鵝' to talk about the animal itself or in compound words related to geese.
It can be the subject or object of a sentence, for example, 'The goose is swimming.'
'鵝' can also appear in contexts describing food or nature.
The word remains the same whether singular or plural; context or numbers clarify quantity.
